behavior: A viewport that can scroll is a tab stop only while its content holds no tab stop, as Chromium does for a native scroll container. A control in the content scrolls the viewport with the keyboard, so Tab goes from the element before the scroll area to that control, in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The first focus of a dialog whose body scrolls goes to its first control at each open. Base UI keeps `tabindex="0"` on a viewport that holds a control, so Tab stops at the viewport first.
